titre: Tiquiz review: a Systeme.io expert's verdict
description: Does Tiquiz deliver on Systeme.io? A Systeme.io expert puts it through its paces on video, plus real customer results and the honest limits. Quizzes, leads and tags without Zapier.
motsCles: create a quiz on systeme io

blocs.html:
TL;DR

Tiquiz builds quizzes, surveys and video pop quizzes that plug straight into Systeme.io.

Your leads land there already tagged, without Zapier or Make.

The free plan (no card, no time limit) is enough to try everything, and a first quiz goes live in under an hour.

Where it falls short: visual customisation and conditional logic are still basic.

Tiquiz builds a quiz, collects the leads and files them in Systeme.io with the right tag, without Zapier or Make.

Which is exactly the bit Systeme.io does not do on its own.

I build Tiquiz. So feel free to take my opinion with a pinch of salt.

The people worth listening to are the ones who use it and have nothing to gain from selling it.

Let's start with Christelle.

Christelle works with coaches, therapists and course creators on Systeme.io.

She built her first quiz in under an hour, connection included, and she walks through the whole thing on screen: building it, the tags, the hand-off to Systeme.io, and the places where it gets fiddly.
Watch her video on YouTube (subscribe to her channel, it is excellent)
Her verdict: the tool does the job, and it saves a huge amount of time. It suits people who do not think of themselves as technical.
Tiquiz builds three formats: quizzes, surveys and video pop quizzes (a quiz that appears while a video plays).

blocs.alt: The three Tiquiz formats: the quiz that qualifies and captures leads, the survey that collects opinions, and the pop quiz that appears during a video

blocs.html:
The point is not to entertain. It is to qualify your prospects and collect leads better than a form does.

The part that matters when you are on Systeme.io: the integration is native.

Someone answers, their email lands in Systeme.io with the tag you picked, and you follow up with the right email sequence.

No Zapier, no Make, no plumbing between ten different tools.

The full walkthrough is here: how to create a quiz on Systeme.io.

blocs.alt: From quiz to mailing list in four steps: someone answers, the profile becomes a tag, the contact lands tagged in Systeme.io, the right email goes out on its own. No Zapier, no code

blocs.html:
You get going fast.

A first quiz live in under an hour, even if you are not comfortable with the technical side.

The Systeme.io integration holds up.

The tags arrive, no contact goes missing, no delay. That is the heart of the tool, and it is solid.

The AI writes your quiz.

You give it your goal and your audience, it drafts a first version, and you adjust by clicking. Hours of writing gone.

Fewer tools in your chain.

Fewer settings, fewer things that can break, and you publish straight away.

The format helps too: a quiz usually converts far better than a form, as Interact's conversion data shows.

A quiz is a living lead magnet, unlike the PDF people download and forget (more lead magnet ideas).

blocs.alt: Classic form: intrusive, rarely filled in, little engagement. Interactive quiz: engages from the first question, collects 2 to 3 times more emails and qualifies the contact

blocs.texte: What the people using it say

blocs.html:
Christelle is not the only one who has had a go with it.

A few pieces of feedback from people on Systeme.io:

Sebastien runs ads to a funnel built around a quiz: “I halved my cost per lead”.

Another customer, starting from a brand new account, collected 680 new contacts in one month, from her quiz alone.

One participant spotted, thanks to the question-by-question tracking, that her question 2 was scaring people off. She swapped two questions around and her completion rate went up, without a single extra visitor.

What they have in common: the tool alone is not what produces the result. It is a quiz that is well built and properly wired in.

blocs.alt: The Trustpilot page for Tiquiz: 4.2 out of 5, rated by 6 reviews, with the breakdown from five stars down to one

blocs.html:
Two things are missing today.

Visual customisation.

Colours, logo, font: those are yours to set.

A pixel-perfect design for a very precise brand guide: not yet.

Advanced conditional logic.

Multi-branch paths that change with every answer are not what Tiquiz is built for right now.

The tool moves fast, so both of these may well shift over the coming months.

blocs.alt: What works: a first quiz in under an hour, a reliable Systeme.io integration, the AI does the writing. The limits: basic visual customisation, no advanced conditional logic

blocs.html:
Start with the free plan.

It lets you build your first quiz, connect it to Systeme.io and publish it. No card, no time limit.

Paying lifts the ceilings: more responses, more projects, your own domain, and the Tiquiz mention disappears (which looks more professional).

The sensible order: test on the free plan, check that it actually brings you leads, then upgrade.

For you if you are a coach, therapist, course creator or consultant on Systeme.io, and you want to capture and segment your contacts without spending your days on it.

Less so if your needs are very technical, if you have a brand guide to follow to the millimetre, or if you need complex conditional paths.

For the vast majority of solopreneurs on Systeme.io, it does the job.

blocs.texte: A quiz does not pay off on its own

blocs.html:
Tiquiz builds the quiz. That is already a lot.

But a quiz sitting online does not fill your list by magic.

Sending traffic to it, sorting your leads, following up, selling: that is a method, not a feature.

Which is why I built the Atelier du Quiz: 7 days to put the whole system around your quiz in place.

The free traffic plan, email sequences ready to paste, a coach available day and night, and free Tiquiz access included.

Tiquiz gives you the tool. The Atelier gives you the system that makes it pay.

questions.question: Is Tiquiz really free, or is there a catch?
questions.reponse:
The free plan is genuinely free: you build your first quiz, connect it to Systeme.io and publish it, with no card and no time limit.

You only pay the day you want more volume, more projects or your own domain.

In other words, you can prove it brings you leads before spending a penny.

questions.question: Do my contacts really land in Systeme.io, with the right tag?
questions.reponse:
Yes, that is the heart of the tool.

The integration is native: as soon as someone answers, their email goes to Systeme.io with the tag you set, without Zapier or Make.

You can then trigger the email sequence that matches their profile.

In testing, the tags arrive with no delay and no contact goes missing.

questions.question: I am not technical at all, am I going to struggle?
questions.reponse:
No. There is nothing to code.

The AI drafts a first version of your quiz from your goal, you adjust by clicking, and the Systeme.io connection is guided step by step.

Most people have their first quiz live in under an hour.

questions.question: Does a quiz really convert better than a plain form?
questions.reponse:
Generally yes, and by a long way.

A quiz engages the person, gets them answering, and gives them something useful in exchange for their email.

You end up with a better-qualified contact than a bare email field gives you, because you know who they are and what they want.

Conversion reports on interactive quizzes confirm it year after year.

questions.question: Can I match my quiz to my brand colours?
questions.reponse:
Partly.

You set your colours, your logo and your font, and the result looks clean. That said, if you have a very precise brand guide and you want a pixel-perfect custom design, you will feel the limits today.

It is an area the tool keeps improving.

questions.question: What is the difference between Tiquiz and the Atelier du Quiz?
questions.reponse:
Tiquiz is the tool that builds the quiz.

The Atelier du Quiz is the 7-day method for building the whole system around it: bringing traffic in, sorting the leads, following up and selling.

One does not replace the other.

The Atelier includes free Tiquiz access, so you can start without paying anything extra.

questions.question: Does Tiquiz do surveys and quizzes on video too?
questions.reponse:
Yes.

Alongside quizzes, you can build surveys to gather opinions, and video pop quizzes, meaning a quiz that appears during your YouTube video to capture leads at the moment attention is highest.
